high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "stormreid," who is located in Los Angeles, California. The post features a celebratory moment at what appears to be the Creative Arts Emmy Awards, as indicated by the backdrop with the Emmys logo and the text "75th Creative Arts Emmys" and "Television Academy." In the photo, Storm Reid is standing on a red carpet, wearing a glamorous pink strapless gown with a sequined skirt that sparkles under the lights. She is holding up a golden trophy, which suggests she has won an award. Her expression is one of joy and surprise
